Kirara Hoshi (星 綺羅羅, *Hoshi Kirara*) is a third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kirara has partnered with Hakari while running his fight club. Their Cursed Technique is Love Rendezvous (星間飛行, *Rabu Randebū*), a complex technique whose motif is based on the Southern Cross constellation. For someone marked with one star to approach someone marked with another star, they must follow a determined order, or else targets of the same star will attract each other. The order follows the stars from nearest to furthest distance to the Earth: Imai, Acrux, Mimosa, Ginan, and Gacrux. They agree to Megumi and Yuji's request for help, after hearing about everything that transpired at Shibuya and after. Kirara is later outside the barriers of the Culling Game serving as the provider of intel for one group.

The "[Big Three](/wiki/Allies_of_World_War_II "Allies of World War II")" at the [Yalta Conference](/wiki/Yalta_Conference "Yalta Conference") in 1945; seated (from the left): [Winston Churchill](/wiki/Winston_Churchill "Winston Churchill"), [Franklin D. Roosevelt](/wiki/Franklin_D._Roosevelt "Franklin D. Roosevelt") and [Joseph Stalin](/wiki/Joseph_Stalin "Joseph Stalin")

After the staggering [Battle of Stalingrad](/wiki/Battle_of_Stalingrad "Battle of Stalingrad") in 1943, the German offensive in the Soviet Union turned into a continual fallback. The [Battle of Kursk](/wiki/Battle_of_Kursk "Battle of Kursk"), which involved the largest [tank battle](/wiki/Battle_of_Prokhorovka "Battle of Prokhorovka") in history, was the last major German offensive on the [Eastern Front](/wiki/Eastern_Front_(World_War_II) "Eastern Front (World War II)"). In June 1944, British and American forces invaded France in the [D-Day landings](/wiki/Normandy_landings "Normandy landings"), opening a new front against Germany. Berlin finally [fell in 1945](/wiki/Battle_of_Berlin "Battle of Berlin"), ending the Second World War in Europe. ExxonMobil :: History :: chunk_0001
Main article: [History of ExxonMobil](/wiki/History_of_ExxonMobil "History of ExxonMobil")

Originally, [Vacuum Oil Company](/wiki/Vacuum_Oil_Company "Vacuum Oil Company") was founded in 1866. Vacuum Oil later was acquired by [Standard Oil](/wiki/Standard_Oil "Standard Oil") in 1879, divested from Standard in 1911 with [its legally-mandated breakup](/wiki/Standard_Oil_Co._of_New_Jersey_v._United_States "Standard Oil Co. of New Jersey v. United States"), and merged by the Standard Oil Company of New York (Socony), later known as [Mobil](/wiki/Mobil "Mobil"), in 1931. After the 1911 breakup, Standard Oil continued to exist through its New Jersey subsidiary (Jersey Standard), and retained its name in much of the eastern United States. Jersey Standard grew by acquiring [Humble Oil](/wiki/Humble_Oil "Humble Oil") in the 1930s and became the dominant oil company on the world stage.

The company's lack of ownership over the Standard Oil name across the United States, however, prompted a name change to unify all of its brands under one name, choosing Exxon in 1972 instead of continuing to use the three distinct brands [Esso](/wiki/Esso "Esso"), [Enco](/wiki/Enco_(brand) "Enco (brand)"), and [Humble Oil](/wiki/Humble_Oil "Humble Oil").[[16]](#cite_note-17)[[17]](#cite_note-Kumar_2019_101–109-18)

In 1998, the two companies agreed to merge and form ExxonMobil, with the deal closing on November 30, 1999. The new company's name containing both of the trade names of its immediate predecessors. However, the structure of the merger provided that Exxon was the surviving company and bought Mobil, rather than a new company being created.[[17]](#cite_note-Kumar_2019_101–109-18)[[18]](#cite_note-19)[[19]](#cite_note-20)[[20]](#cite_note-21) Following the merger, Exxon's NYSE ticker symbol was changed from "XON"[[21]](#cite_note-22) to "XOM".

fanoutqa_005755.t: Essential amino acid :: Amino acid requirements and the amino acid content of food :: Protein quality :: chunk_0008
fanoutqa_005755.x:
Essential amino acid :: Amino acid requirements and the amino acid content of food :: Protein quality :: chunk_0008
Main article: [Protein quality](/wiki/Protein_quality "Protein quality")

Various attempts have been made to express the "quality" or "value" of various kinds of protein. Measures include the [biological value](/wiki/Biological_value "Biological value"), [net protein utilization](/wiki/Net_protein_utilization "Net protein utilization"), [protein efficiency ratio](/wiki/Protein_efficiency_ratio "Protein efficiency ratio"), [protein digestibility corrected amino acid score](/wiki/Protein_digestibility_corrected_amino_acid_score "Protein digestibility corrected amino acid score") and the [complete proteins](/wiki/Complete_protein "Complete protein") concept. These concepts are important in the [livestock industry](/wiki/Animal_husbandry "Animal husbandry"), because the relative lack of one or more of the essential amino acids in [animal feeds](/wiki/Fodder "Fodder") would have a limiting effect on growth and thus on [feed conversion ratio](/wiki/Feed_conversion_ratio "Feed conversion ratio"). Thus, various feedstuffs may be fed in combination to increase net protein utilization, or a [supplement](/wiki/Dietary_supplement "Dietary supplement") of an individual amino acid (methionine, lysine, threonine, or tryptophan) can be added to the feed.

fanoutqa_030331.x:
Casino Royale (2006 film) :: Plot :: part 02 :: chunk_0003
Bond awakens in hospital and recovers with Vesper at his side. He has Mathis arrested, believing that he had tipped off Le Chiffre about his tell. Bond falls in love with Vesper and resigns from MI6; the couple sail to Venice. When M reveals that his winnings were never transferred to the British treasury, Bond realises that Vesper has betrayed him and he tracks her to an exchange of the money. Gunmen spot him and take her captive inside a gutted Venetian palace undergoing restoration and supported by large flotation devices. Bond destroys the flotation devices, causing the palace to lurch and sink into the [Grand Canal](/wiki/Grand_Canal_(Venice) "Grand Canal (Venice)"). While he kills the shooters, Vesper is trapped in an elevator cage as it submerges. Bond dives in to rescue her, but she locks herself in to prevent him and she drowns. Bond later fails to [resuscitate](/wiki/Resuscitation "Resuscitation") her, and Mr. White escapes with the money.

M informs Bond, who has returned to service, that the organisation behind Le Chiffre[[a]](#cite_note-8) threatened to kill Vesper's lover unless she became a double agent. When Bond denounces Vesper as a traitor, M reasons that she likely made a deal with White by trading the winnings for Bond's life. Realising Vesper left her phone to help him, Bond checks her contacts and locates Mr. White at an estate in Lake Como. He shoots White in the leg to disable him and introduces himself: "The name's Bond, James Bond".

***Avatar*** is a 2009 epic [science fiction film](/wiki/Science_fiction_film "Science fiction film") written and directed by [James Cameron](/wiki/James_Cameron "James Cameron"). It features an [ensemble cast](/wiki/Ensemble_cast "Ensemble cast") including [Sam Worthington](/wiki/Sam_Worthington "Sam Worthington"), [Zoe Saldaña](/wiki/Zoe_Salda%C3%B1a "Zoe Saldaña"), [Stephen Lang](/wiki/Stephen_Lang "Stephen Lang"), [Michelle Rodriguez](/wiki/Michelle_Rodriguez "Michelle Rodriguez"), and [Sigourney Weaver](/wiki/Sigourney_Weaver "Sigourney Weaver"). It is the first in [the *Avatar* film series](/wiki/Avatar_(franchise) "Avatar (franchise)"). It is set in the mid-22nd century, when humans are colonizing [Pandora](/wiki/Pandora_(Avatar) "Pandora (Avatar)"), a lush [habitable moon](/wiki/Habitable_moon "Habitable moon"), in order to mine the valuable mineral [unobtanium](/wiki/Unobtainium "Unobtainium").[[d]](#cite_note-14) The expansion of the mining colony threatens the existence of a local tribe of [Na'vi](/wiki/Fictional_universe_of_Avatar#Na'vi "Fictional universe of Avatar"), a [humanoid](/wiki/Humanoid "Humanoid") species indigenous to Pandora. The title of the film refers to an "avatar", which is a [genetically engineered](/wiki/Genetic_engineering "Genetic engineering") Na'vi body remotely operated from the brain of a human, and which is used to [interact](/wiki/Telepresence "Telepresence") with the Na'vi.

Development of *Avatar* began in 1994, when Cameron wrote an 80-page treatment for the film. Filming was due to take place after the completion of Cameron's 1997 film *[Titanic](/wiki/Titanic_(1997_film) "Titanic (1997 film)")*, for a planned release in 1999; however, according to Cameron, the necessary technology was not yet available to achieve his vision of the film.
